newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - COLUMBIA/HCA MORE DETAILS.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - COLUMBIA/HCA MORE DETAILS.

text.p: Goldman Sachs analyst Deborah Lawson said Tuesday she added Columbia/HCA Corp to the firm's recommended list, believing much of the negative news around the stock had already been factored into the share price.
-- Lawson said in a research note she cut her 1998 earnings estimate to $2.70 per share from $2.86 per share and set a 1999 estimate of $3.15 per share.

-- "We believe a tremendous amount of negative news and earnings impact is already factored into shares," she said. "Therefore we believe further downside is fairly limited. Additionally, reported interest by Tenet HealthCare in a possible business combination with Columbia should provide considerable additional downside protection for the shares."
-- Last week, the for-profit hospital company said it would take dramatic steps to change its business and deal with a massive federal investigation.
